ShortDescription.Value: Local MCP bridge for inspecting and building Cities: Skylines II cities. Requires a separate MCP server.

Publish.LongDescription:
CityWeaver is a code mod that provides an authenticated local bridge for external MCP tools. With a separately installed compatible CityWeaver MCP server, those tools can inspect a loaded city and run supported construction workflows through the game's native preview and apply systems.
This Paradox Mods download contains the in-game bridge only. It does not include the Node.js MCP server or an AI client, and it does not add standalone in-game construction controls. Without the companion server, the bridge has no user-facing city tools.
The bridge binds to 127.0.0.1 and creates a new authentication token each time it starts. Construction tools can change your city and spend in-game money. Back up important saves before using them. Some features have not been verified in every game version or map.

ChangeLog.Value: Initial Paradox Mods release. Updated for game 1.6.2f1 and removed the misleading MCP client activity indicator from mod settings.
